sanskrit: abhyāgacchati dāśārhe prajñācakṣur mahāmanāḥ sahaiva bhīṣmadroṇābhyām udatiṣṭhan mahāyaśāḥ
english: When the scion of Dāśārha drew near, the great-minded one whose eyes are wisdom, together with Bhīṣma and Droṇa, the greatly renowned one rose to his feet.

sanskrit: uttiṣṭhati mahārāje dhṛtarāṣṭre janeśvare tāni rājasahasrāṇi samuttasthuḥ samantataḥ
english: When the great king Dhṛtarāṣṭra, lord of men, rose, those thousands of kings rose on all sides.

sanskrit: āsanaṃ sarvatobhadraṃ jāmbūnadapariṣkṛtam kṛṣṇārthe kalpitaṃ tatra dhṛtarāṣṭrasya śāsanāt
english: A seat auspicious on all sides, adorned with gold, had been prepared there for Kṛṣṇa by Dhṛtarāṣṭra's command.

sanskrit: smayamānas tu rājānaṃ bhīṣmadroṇau ca mādhavaḥ abhyabhāṣata dharmātmā rājñaś cānyān yathāvayaḥ
english: Smiling, the Mādhava, righteous of soul, addressed the king, Bhīṣma and Droṇa, and the other kings each according to his seniority.

sanskrit: tatra keśavam ānarcuḥ samyag abhyāgataṃ sabhām rājānaḥ pārthivāḥ sarve kuravaś ca janārdanam
english: There all the kings, the lords of earth, and the Kurus honored Keśava, Janārdana, who had arrived properly in the assembly.

sanskrit: tatra tiṣṭhan sa dāśārho rājamadhye paraṃtapaḥ apaśyad antarikṣasthān ṛṣīn parapuraṃjayaḥ
english: Standing there in the midst of the kings, that scorcher of foes, the scion of Dāśārha, conqueror of enemy cities, saw sages stationed in the sky.

sanskrit: tatas tān abhisaṃprekṣya nāradapramukhān ṛṣīn abhyabhāṣata dāśārho bhīṣmaṃ śāṃtanavaṃ śanaiḥ
english: Then, having looked toward those sages headed by Nārada, the scion of Dāśārha addressed Bhīṣma, son of Śaṃtanu, quietly.

sanskrit: pārthivīṃ samitiṃ draṣṭum ṛṣayo 'bhyāgatā nṛpa nimantryantām āsanaiś ca satkāreṇa ca bhūyasā
english: "The sages have come to witness this assembly of kings, O lord. Let them be invited in and honored greatly with seats and with due respect."

sanskrit: naiteṣv anupaviṣṭeṣu śakyaṃ kena cid āsitum pūjā prayujyatām āśu munīnāṃ bhāvitātmanām
english: "While these have not yet been seated, it is not fitting for anyone to remain seated. Let worship be offered at once to these sages of purified souls."

sanskrit: ṛṣīñ śāṃtanavo dṛṣṭvā sabhādvāram upasthitān tvaramāṇas tato bhṛtyān āsanānīty acodayat
english: Śaṃtanu's son, seeing the sages standing at the door of the assembly, hastened and urged his attendants, saying "Bring seats!"

sanskrit: āsanāny atha mṛṣṭāni mahānti vipulāni ca maṇikāñcanacitrāṇi samājahrus tatas tataḥ
english: Then polished seats, great and wide, adorned with gems and gold, were brought from here and there.

sanskrit: teṣu tatropaviṣṭeṣu gṛhītārgheṣu bhārata niṣasādāsane kṛṣṇo rājānaś ca yathāsanam
english: When they had been seated there and had received their respectful offerings, O Bhārata, Kṛṣṇa took his seat, and the kings took their seats each in his proper place.

sanskrit: duḥśāsanaḥ sātyakaye dadāv āsanam uttamam viviṃśatir dadau pīṭhaṃ kāñcanaṃ kṛtavarmaṇe
english: Duḥśāsana gave an excellent seat to Sātyaki; Viviṃśati gave a golden stool to Kṛtavarman.

sanskrit: avidūre 'tha kṛṣṇasya karṇaduryodhanāv ubhau ekāsane mahātmānau niṣīdatur amarṣaṇau
english: Not far from Kṛṣṇa, Karṇa and Duryodhana, both great-souled and wrathful, sat together on one seat.

sanskrit: gāndhārarājaḥ śakunir gāndhārair abhirakṣitaḥ niṣasādāsane rājā sahaputro viśāṃ pate
english: Śakuni, king of Gāndhāra, guarded by the Gāndhāras, sat on his seat together with his son, O lord of men.

sanskrit: viduro maṇipīṭhe tu śuklaspardhyājinottare saṃspṛśann āsanaṃ śaurer mahāmatir upāviśat
english: Vidura, the great-minded one, took his seat on a jeweled stool spread with a white antelope skin, touching the seat of the Shaura.

sanskrit: cirasya dṛṣṭvā dāśārhaṃ rājānaḥ sarvapārthivāḥ amṛtasyeva nātṛpyan prekṣamāṇā janārdanam
english: Beholding the scion of Dāśārha after a long time, all the kings, all the lords of earth, were not satiated in gazing at Janārdana, as if looking upon nectar.

sanskrit: atasīpuṣpasaṃkāśaḥ pītavāsā janārdanaḥ vyabhrājata sabhāmadhye hemnīvopahito maṇiḥ
english: Janārdana, resembling the blossom of the flax flower and clad in yellow garments, shone in the midst of the assembly like a jewel set in gold.

sanskrit: tatas tūṣṇīṃ sarvam āsīd govindagatamānasam na tatra kaś cit kiṃ cid dhi vyājahāra pumān kva cit
english: Then all fell silent, their minds fixed on Govinda; there no man anywhere spoke a single word.

sanskrit: vaiśaṃpāyana uvāca teṣv āsīneṣu sarveṣu tūṣṇīṃbhūteṣu rājasu vākyam abhyādade kṛṣṇaḥ sudaṃṣṭro dundubhisvanaḥ
english: Vaiśaṃpāyana said: When all those kings had been seated and fallen silent, Kṛṣṇa of fine teeth, whose voice is like a kettledrum, began to speak.

sanskrit: jīmūta iva gharmānte sarvāṃ saṃśrāvayan sabhām dhṛtarāṣṭram abhiprekṣya samabhāṣata mādhavaḥ
english: Like a rain-cloud at summer's end, making the entire assembly hear his words, the Mādhava, looking toward Dhṛtarāṣṭra, spoke.

sanskrit: kurūṇāṃ pāṇḍavānāṃ ca śamaḥ syād iti bhārata aprayatnena vīrāṇām etad yatitum āgataḥ
english: "I have come here to attempt, without great effort, that there might be peace between the Kurus and the Pāṇḍavas, O Bhārata."

sanskrit: rājan nānyat pravaktavyaṃ tava niḥśreyasaṃ vacaḥ viditaṃ hy eva te sarvaṃ veditavyam ariṃdama
english: "O king, there is no other word to speak for your ultimate good — for everything that ought to be known is already known to you, O subduer of foes."

sanskrit: idam adya kulaṃ śreṣṭhaṃ sarvarājasu pārthiva śrutavṛttopasaṃpannaṃ sarvaiḥ samuditaṃ guṇaiḥ
english: "This lineage stands today as foremost among all kings, O lord of earth — endowed with learning and good conduct, complete in all virtues."

sanskrit: kṛpānukampā kāruṇyam ānṛśaṃsyaṃ ca bhārata tathārjavaṃ kṣamā satyaṃ kuruṣv etad viśiṣyate
english: "Compassion, fellow-feeling, tender-heartedness, harmlessness, straightforwardness, forbearance, truth — these are pre-eminent among the Kurus, O Bhārata."

sanskrit: tasminn evaṃvidhe rājan kule mahati tiṣṭhati tvannimittaṃ viśeṣeṇa neha yuktam asāṃpratam
english: "In so great a family endowed with such qualities, O king, what is unseemly and improper is not fitting here — most especially on your account."

sanskrit: tvaṃ hi vārayitā śreṣṭhaḥ kurūṇāṃ kurusattama mithyā pracaratāṃ tāta bāhyeṣv ābhyantareṣu ca
english: "For you are the foremost restrainer of the Kurus, O best of Kurus — of those who go astray in external and internal matters, dear king."

sanskrit: te putrās tava kauravya duryodhanapurogamāḥ dharmārthau pṛṣṭhataḥ kṛtvā pracaranti nṛśaṃsavat
english: "Those sons of yours, O Kauravya, headed by Duryodhana, having cast dharma and artha behind them, conduct themselves cruelly."

sanskrit: aśiṣṭā gatamaryādā lobhena hṛtacetasaḥ sveṣu bandhuṣu mukhyeṣu tad vettha bharatarṣabha
english: "Ill-mannered, having abandoned all limits, their minds stolen by greed — toward their own foremost kinsmen — this you know, O bull of the Bhāratas."

sanskrit: seyam āpan mahāghorā kuruṣv eva samutthitā upekṣyamāṇā kauravya pṛthivīṃ ghātayiṣyati
english: "This most terrible calamity that has arisen among the Kurus themselves — if ignored, O Kauravya, will destroy the earth."

sanskrit: śakyā ceyaṃ śamayituṃ tvaṃ ced icchasi bhārata na duṣkaro hy atra śamo mato me bharatarṣabha
english: "And this can be pacified, if you are willing, O Bhārata — for in my view the peace here is not difficult, O bull of the Bhāratas."

sanskrit: tvayy adhīnaḥ śamo rājan mayi caiva viśāṃ pate putrān sthāpaya kauravya sthāpayiṣyāmy ahaṃ parān
english: "Peace depends on you, O king, and on me, O lord of men. You restrain your sons, O Kauravya, and I shall restrain the others."

sanskrit: ājñā tava hi rājendra kāryā putraiḥ sahānvayaiḥ hitaṃ balavad apy eṣāṃ tiṣṭhatāṃ tava śāsane
english: "For your command, O king of kings, must be carried out by your sons and kinsmen together; even the powerful ones among them would benefit from abiding by your rule."

sanskrit: tava caiva hitaṃ rājan pāṇḍavānām atho hitam śame prayatamānasya mama śāsanakāṅkṣiṇām
english: "And what is beneficial to you, O king, is equally beneficial to the Pāṇḍavas — who strive for peace and who await my guidance."

sanskrit: svayaṃ niṣkalam ālakṣya saṃvidhatsva viśāṃ pate sahabhūtās tu bharatās tavaiva syur janeśvara
english: "Seeing yourself as whole and undivided, make your arrangements, O lord of men — let the Bharatas be united and they shall be yours alone, O lord of the people."

sanskrit: dharmārthayos tiṣṭha rājan pāṇḍavair abhirakṣitaḥ na hi śakyās tathābhūtā yatnād api narādhipa
english: "Abide in dharma and artha, O king, protected by the Pāṇḍavas — for beings of such stature cannot be overcome even with effort, O lord of men."

sanskrit: na hi tvāṃ pāṇḍavair jetuṃ rakṣyamāṇaṃ mahātmabhiḥ indro 'pi devaiḥ sahitaḥ prasaheta kuto nṛpāḥ
english: "Indeed, even Indra together with the gods could not overcome you protected by those great-souled Pāṇḍavas — how much less mere kings?"

sanskrit: yatra bhīṣmaś ca droṇaś ca kṛpaḥ karṇo viviṃśatiḥ aśvatthāmā vikarṇaś ca somadatto 'tha bāhlikaḥ
english: "Where Bhīṣma and Droṇa and Kṛpa, Karṇa and Viviṃśati, Aśvatthāmā and Vikarṇa, Somadatta and Bāhlika —"

sanskrit: saindhavaś ca kaliṅgaś ca kāmbojaś ca sudakṣiṇaḥ yudhiṣṭhiro bhīmasenaḥ savyasācī yamau tathā
english: "— and Saindhava, and the king of Kaliṅga, and Sudakṣiṇa of Kāmboja, and Yudhiṣṭhira, Bhīmasena, Savyasācī, and the twins as well —"

sanskrit: sātyakiś ca mahātejā yuyutsuś ca mahārathaḥ ko nu tān viparītātmā yudhyeta bharatarṣabha
english: "— and the greatly resplendent Sātyaki and Yuyutsu the great chariot-warrior — what perverse soul would fight against them, O bull of the Bhāratas?"

sanskrit: lokasyeśvaratāṃ bhūyaḥ śatrubhiś cāpradhṛṣyatām prāpsyasi tvam amitraghna sahitaḥ kurupāṇḍavaiḥ
english: "Lordship over the world and invincibility before enemies — this you shall again attain, O slayer of foes, united with the Kurus and Pāṇḍavas."

sanskrit: tasya te pṛthivīpālās tvatsamāḥ pṛthivīpate śreyāṃsaś caiva rājānaḥ saṃdhāsyante paraṃtapa
english: "With you as their lord, O protector of the earth, kings who are your equals and those even greater will make alliance with you, O scorcher of foes."

sanskrit: sa tvaṃ putraiś ca pautraiś ca bhrātṛbhiḥ pitṛbhis tathā suhṛdbhiḥ sarvato guptaḥ sukhaṃ śakṣyasi jīvitum
english: "So you, guarded on all sides by sons and grandsons, by brothers and fathers, and by friends, shall be able to live in happiness."

sanskrit: etān eva purodhāya satkṛtya ca yathā purā akhilāṃ bhokṣyase sarvāṃ pṛthivīṃ pṛthivīpate
english: "With these Pāṇḍavas placed before you and honored as before, you shall enjoy the entire earth without remainder, O protector of the earth."

sanskrit: etair hi sahitaḥ sarvaiḥ pāṇḍavaiḥ svaiś ca bhārata anyān vijeṣyase śatrūn eṣa svārthas tavākhilaḥ
english: "For united with all these Pāṇḍavas and your own men, O Bhārata, you shall conquer other enemies — this is your complete self-interest."

sanskrit: tair evopārjitāṃ bhūmiṃ bhokṣyase ca paraṃtapa yadi saṃpatsyase putraiḥ sahāmātyair narādhipa
english: "And you shall enjoy the earth won by those very ones, O scorcher of foes, if you come to terms with them, together with your sons and ministers, O lord of men."

sanskrit: saṃyuge vai mahārāja dṛśyate sumahān kṣayaḥ kṣaye cobhayato rājan kaṃ dharmam anupaśyasi
english: "In battle, O great king, a very great destruction is seen; and with destruction on both sides, O king, what dharma do you perceive?"

sanskrit: pāṇḍavair nihataiḥ saṃkhye putrair vāpi mahābalaiḥ yad vindethāḥ sukhaṃ rājaṃs tad brūhi bharatarṣabha
english: "Whatever happiness you would find, O king, from the Pāṇḍavas being slain in battle, or from your own mighty sons being slain — tell me that, O bull of the Bhāratas."

sanskrit: śūrāś ca hi kṛtāstrāś ca sarve yuddhābhikāṅkṣiṇaḥ pāṇḍavās tāvakāś caiva tān rakṣa mahato bhayāt
english: "For all are heroes and trained in weapons, all longing for battle — the Pāṇḍavas and your own men. Protect them from this great peril."

sanskrit: na paśyema kurūn sarvān pāṇḍavāṃś caiva saṃyuge kṣīṇān ubhayataḥ śūrān rathebhyo rathibhir hatān
english: "May we not see all the Kurus and the Pāṇḍavas destroyed in battle, the heroes on both sides slain from their chariots by chariot-warriors."

sanskrit: samavetāḥ pṛthivyāṃ hi rājāno rājasattama amarṣavaśam āpannā nāśayeyur imāḥ prajāḥ
english: "For the kings assembled on the earth, O best of kings, having fallen under the sway of wrath, would destroy these people."

sanskrit: trāhi rājann imaṃ lokaṃ na naśyeyur imāḥ prajāḥ tvayi prakṛtim āpanne śeṣaṃ syāt kurunandana
english: "Save this world, O king, let these people not perish — if you return to your true nature, a remnant shall survive, O joy of the Kurus."

sanskrit: śuklā vadānyā hrīmanta āryāḥ puṇyābhijātayaḥ anyonyasacivā rājaṃs tān pāhi mahato bhayāt
english: "Pure, generous, modest, noble, born of auspicious lineage, mutually allied as counselors — protect them, O king, from this great danger."

sanskrit: śiveneme bhūmipālāḥ samāgamya parasparam saha bhuktvā ca pītvā ca pratiyāntu yathāgṛham
english: "May these lords of the earth meet one another auspiciously, eat and drink together, and return home each to his own house."

sanskrit: suvāsasaḥ sragviṇaś ca satkṛtya bharatarṣabha amarṣāṃś ca nirākṛtya vairāṇi ca paraṃtapa
english: "Clad in fine garments and wearing garlands, having been properly honored, O bull of the Bhāratas, and with wrath and enmities set aside, O scorcher of foes."

sanskrit: hārdaṃ yat pāṇḍaveṣv āsīt prāpte 'sminn āyuṣaḥ kṣaye tad eva te bhavatv adya śaśvac ca bharatarṣabha
english: "Whatever affection was in your heart toward the Pāṇḍavas before this wasting of life's span arrived — let that same be yours now and always, O bull of the Bhāratas."

sanskrit: bālā vihīnāḥ pitrā te tvayaiva parivardhitāḥ tān pālaya yathānyāyaṃ putrāṃś ca bharatarṣabha
english: "They were children deprived of their father and were raised by you yourself — protect them as is right and just, as your own sons, O bull of the Bhāratas."

sanskrit: bhavataiva hi rakṣyās te vyasaneṣu viśeṣataḥ mā te dharmas tathaivārtho naśyeta bharatarṣabha
english: "For they are to be protected by you especially in times of adversity — let not your dharma and likewise your artha perish, O bull of the Bhāratas."

sanskrit: āhus tvāṃ pāṇḍavā rājann abhivādya prasādya ca bhavataḥ śāsanād duḥkham anubhūtaṃ sahānugaiḥ
english: "The Pāṇḍavas say this to you, O king, paying homage and seeking to propitiate you: 'Under your command we have endured suffering together with our followers.'"

sanskrit: dvādaśemāni varṣāṇi vane nirvyuṣitāni naḥ trayodaśaṃ tathājñātaiḥ sajane parivatsaram
english: "'These twelve years have been spent by us in the forest; and the thirteenth year — a full year unrecognized among people.'"

sanskrit: sthātā naḥ samaye tasmin piteti kṛtaniścayāḥ nāhāsma samayaṃ tāta tac ca no brāhmaṇā viduḥ
english: "'Being resolved that you would stand by the agreement as a father, we did not abandon the covenant, dear father — and the brahmanas know this of us.'"

sanskrit: tasmin naḥ samaye tiṣṭha sthitānāṃ bharatarṣabha nityaṃ saṃkleśitā rājan svarājyāṃśaṃ labhemahi
english: "'Stand by that covenant with us who have stood by it, O bull of the Bhāratas; though we have ever been afflicted, O king, may we obtain our share of the royal domain.'"

sanskrit: tvaṃ dharmam arthaṃ yuñjānaḥ samyaṅ nas trātum arhasi gurutvaṃ bhavati prekṣya bahūn kleśāṃs titikṣmahe
english: "'You, who are engaged rightly in dharma and artha, ought to protect us properly; looking to your greatness, we have endured many afflictions.'"

sanskrit: sa bhavān mātṛpitṛvad asmāsu pratipadyatām guror garīyasī vṛttir yā ca śiṣyasya bhārata
english: "'May you act toward us as a mother and father; greater than a teacher's conduct is that of a disciple, O Bhārata.'"

sanskrit: pitrā sthāpayitavyā hi vayam utpatham āsthitāḥ saṃsthāpaya pathiṣv asmāṃs tiṣṭha rājan svavartmani
english: "'For we who have taken to a wrong path are to be set right by a father — establish us in the right paths; abide yourself, O king, in your own way.'"

sanskrit: āhuś cemāṃ pariṣadaṃ putrās te bharatarṣabha dharmajñeṣu sabhāsatsu neha yuktam asāṃpratam
english: "And your sons say regarding this assembly, O bull of the Bhāratas: 'Among those seated in the assembly who know dharma, what is unseemly and improper is not fitting here.'"

sanskrit: yatra dharmo hy adharmeṇa satyaṃ yatrānṛtena ca hanyate prekṣamāṇānāṃ hatās tatra sabhāsadaḥ
english: "Where dharma is slain by adharma, and where truth is slain by falsehood, while those present look on — those members of the assembly are themselves slain."

sanskrit: viddho dharmo hy adharmeṇa sabhāṃ yatra prapadyate na cāsya śalyaṃ kṛntanti viddhās tatra sabhāsadaḥ dharma etān ārujati yathā nady anukūlajān
english: "Where dharma, wounded by adharma, enters an assembly, and they do not remove its dart — the members of that assembly are themselves wounded; dharma roots them out as a river uproots trees growing on its bank."

sanskrit: ye dharmam anupaśyantas tūṣṇīṃ dhyāyanta āsate te satyam āhur dharmaṃ ca nyāyyaṃ ca bharatarṣabha
english: "Those who, perceiving dharma, sit silent in contemplation — they speak the truth and dharma and what is right, O bull of the Bhāratas."

sanskrit: śakyaṃ kim anyad vaktuṃ te dānād anyaj janeśvara bruvantu vā mahīpālāḥ sabhāyāṃ ye samāsate dharmārthau saṃpradhāryaiva yadi satyaṃ bravīmy aham
english: "What else can be said to you, O lord of men, besides 'give'? Let the lords of earth who are seated in this assembly speak — I speak truly, having fully weighed dharma and artha."

sanskrit: pramuñcemān mṛtyupāśāt kṣatriyān kṣatriyarṣabha praśāmya bharataśreṣṭha mā manyuvaśam anvagāḥ
english: "Free these kshatriyas from the noose of death, O bull among kshatriyas; be pacified, O foremost of the Bhāratas — do not follow the path of anger."

sanskrit: pitryaṃ tebhyaḥ pradāyāṃśaṃ pāṇḍavebhyo yathocitam tataḥ saputraḥ siddhārthaḥ bhuṅkṣva bhogān paraṃtapa
english: "Having given to the Pāṇḍavas their paternal share as is fitting, then enjoy the pleasures with your sons, your purpose accomplished, O scorcher of foes."

sanskrit: ajātaśatruṃ jānīṣe sthitaṃ dharme satāṃ sadā saputre tvayi vṛttiṃ ca vartate yāṃ narādhipa
english: "You know Ajātaśatru — ever established in the dharma of the good; and the conduct that he shows toward you and your sons, O lord of men."

sanskrit: dāhitaś ca nirastaś ca tvām evopāśritaḥ punaḥ indraprasthaṃ tvayaivāsau saputreṇa vivāsitaḥ
english: "Though he was burned and expelled, he again took refuge in you; he was banished from Indraprastha by you yourself with your sons."

sanskrit: sa tatra nivasan sarvān vaśam ānīya pārthivān tvanmukhān akarod rājan na ca tvām atyavartata
english: "He, dwelling there, having brought all the kings under his sway, made them look to you as their head, O king, and did not transgress against you."

sanskrit: tasyaivaṃ vartamānasya saubalena jihīrṣatā rāṣṭrāṇi dhanadhānyaṃ ca prayuktaḥ paramopadhiḥ
english: "Against him who was conducting himself thus, the son of Subala, wishing to seize his kingdoms and wealth and grain, deployed the supreme stratagem of deceit."

sanskrit: sa tām avasthāṃ saṃprāpya kṛṣṇāṃ prekṣya sabhāgatām kṣatradharmād ameyātmā nākampata yudhiṣṭhiraḥ
english: "He, having reached that condition, seeing Draupadī brought into the assembly, Yudhiṣṭhira of immeasurable soul, true to the dharma of the kshatriya, did not waver."

sanskrit: ahaṃ tu tava teṣāṃ ca śreya icchāmi bhārata dharmād arthāt sukhāc caiva mā rājan nīnaśaḥ prajāḥ
english: "I desire the good of both you and them, O Bhārata — in dharma, in artha, and in happiness. Let the people not be destroyed, O king."

sanskrit: anartham arthaṃ manvānā arthaṃ vānartham ātmanaḥ lobhe 'tiprasṛtān putrān nigṛhṇīṣva viśāṃ pate
english: "Your sons, who consider what is harmful to be beneficial and what is beneficial to themselves to be harmful, who have gone too far into greed — restrain them, O lord of men."

sanskrit: sthitāḥ śuśrūṣituṃ pārthāḥ sthitā yoddhum ariṃdamāḥ yat te pathyatamaṃ rājaṃs tasmiṃs tiṣṭha paraṃtapa
english: "The Pārthas stand ready to serve you; those subduer of foes stand ready to fight. Whatever is most beneficial to you, O king — abide in that, O scorcher of foes."
